summary: The agent successfully completed the task by extracting data from PDF and Excel, comparing with type-aware normalization, and outputting domain-specific keys (dropped_categories/adjusted_categories instead of removed_ids/changed_records). The existing skill guided this correctly. The main opportunity for reuse is enhancing compute_diff.py to support custom output key names, so future agents can use the script even when tasks require domain-specific terminology like 'dropped' instead of 'removed'. Also added a validation step recommendation to inspect data shapes before comparing.
